original_title: Tom Holland Is Now The Highest-Grossing Actor Of All Time As Spider-Man: Brand New Day Crosses $2.4 Billion Mark
summary_en: The web-slinger's latest cinematic adventure has propelled Tom Holland to an unprecedented box office milestone. "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" has now crossed the $2.4 billion mark globally, cementing Holland's status as the highest-grossing actor in history.

en.title: Tom Holland's Spider-Man Blockbuster Pushes Him to Highest-Grossing Actor Ever
en.summary: The web-slinger's latest cinematic adventure has propelled Tom Holland to an unprecedented box office milestone. "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" has now crossed the $2.4 billion mark globally, cementing Holland's status as the highest-grossing actor in history.
en.body:
It's a monumental day for **Tom Holland**. With "**Spider-Man: Brand New Day**" continuing its incredible run at the global box office, crossing the staggering $2.4 billion threshold, Holland has officially become the highest-grossing actor of all time. This achievement sees him surpass **Zoe Saldaña**, who previously held the top spot.

"Spider-Man: Brand New Day" is not just a personal victory for Holland; it's also a cinematic powerhouse, now ranking as the third-highest-grossing film ever made. The film's success is a testament to the enduring popularity of the Spider-Man character and Holland's dedicated portrayal, which has resonated with audiences worldwide. His dual role as the friendly neighborhood hero and his participation in other major projects, like Christopher Nolan's "**The Odyssey**" (which also contributed significantly to his earnings), showcase his broad appeal and ability to deliver blockbuster performances across different genres.

## A New King of the Box Office

Holland's ascent to the pinnacle of box office success is a story of consistent performance and strategic project selection. "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" alone has amassed over $2.4 billion worldwide, with reports indicating $875 million from the United States and Canada and $1.366 billion internationally. This immense figure, combined with the performance of "The Odyssey," has placed him firmly at the top of the all-time earners list. The sheer scale of these numbers underscores the massive global appetite for tentpole films, especially those within established and beloved franchises.

## Fan Reactions and Legacy

Fans have been quick to celebrate Holland's achievement, with many taking to online forums and social media to express their excitement. Comments reflect a mix of admiration for his talent and a touch of playful envy, given his high-profile roles and relationships. "Dude is having a hell of a year," one fan noted, echoing a sentiment shared by many. The discussion also touches on dream casting scenarios, with some fans suggesting Holland would have made a great **Tony Stark** – a nod to his significant involvement in the Marvel Cinematic Universe's past sagas. This milestone solidifies Holland's place in cinematic history, not just as a beloved Spider-Man but as a global box office phenomenon.

## What's Next

While "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" nears the end of its theatrical run, its box office legacy is secured. Details regarding Tom Holland's next major projects are eagerly anticipated, though his current standing ensures he will remain a highly sought-after talent in Hollywood for years to come.

content_raw: Thanks to a strong box-office weekend for both Spider-Man: Brand New Day and The Odyssey, Holland has overtaken Zoe Saldaña as the highest grossing lead actor in history
